name: savePreparedKeyboardButton
description: Stores a keyboard button that can be used by a user within a Mini App. Returns a [PreparedKeyboardButton](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#preparedkeyboardbutton) object.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the target user that can use the button

parameters.name: button
parameters.description: A JSON-serialized object describing the button to be saved. The button must be of the type _request\_users_, _request\_chat_, or _request\_managed\_bot_.
